The Title Adora Rawai

Condominium in Rawai
HomePhuket PropertyCondos for SaleThe Title Adora Rawai

Project overview

Coastal condominium in Rawai on Phuket's west coast, designed around sea views and a Mediterranean-inspired concept.

Units range from 30 sqm one-bedroom layouts to 87 sqm two-bedroom layouts. Construction progress was reported at about 69% in October 2026.

Prices, availability and the full facilities list are provided on request: message us on WhatsApp.

The Title Adora Rawai: key facts

  • The Title Adora Rawai is a condominium in Rawai, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC (The Title).
  • Units: 0–2 bedrooms, 30–81 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Mar 2027.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿4,845,263.
  • More projects by Rhom Bho Property in our catalogue: The Nayabella Condominium, The Title Cocoon, Biancana, Casa De Monte, Coralina Kamala, The Title Fizz.
